Individual Mentorship & Dreamwork
with Roman Hanis

Individual guidance for people seeking sustained integration, self-understanding and support through significant life transitions.

Walking With a Mentor

Retreats open doors; mentorship is for the long walk through them. This one-on-one work offers steady, individual accompaniment for people integrating profound experiences, navigating major life thresholds, or seeking a deeper understanding of their own path.

Sessions are shaped around your life rather than a fixed curriculum. Drawing on more than two decades of apprenticeship with Amazonian and Andean wisdom keepers, together with Jungian transpersonal psychology, Roman works with each person’s dreams, questions and daily circumstances as the raw material of the journey — so that insight becomes embodied, and transformation becomes a way of living rather than an event.

What the Work Weaves Together

Amazonian Dreamwork

Transpersonal dreamwork in the Amazonian tradition: learning the language of Nature as it speaks through your dreams and the intelligence of your own organism.

Jungian Depth Psychology

Archetype, symbol and the individuation journey as a bridge between ancestral wisdom and the modern psyche.

Contemplative Inquiry

Sustained self-inquiry and meditation that turn the real questions of your life into daily practice.

Life Integration

Bringing what opens in retreats, ceremonies and peak experiences into durable change in relationship, family, work and service.

Shadow Work

Meeting the disowned parts of ourselves with creative objectivity, so that life’s challenges become the very material of growth.

Embodied Practices

Primordial Breathwork, qigong and other body-based practices, matched to where you are in your process.

Relationship With Nature

Restoring a living relationship with the natural world as teacher, mirror and steady ground.

Purpose & Major Life Transitions

Orientation and companionship through thresholds — vocation, loss, relationship, calling — toward a life of deep meaning and joyful purpose.

Your Mentor

Roman Hanis, co-founder of Paititi Institute, has worked closely with the Indigenous Peruvian cultures of the Amazonian rainforest and Andean mountains since 2001. A healer-curandero pledged by Yahua elders and author of the international bestseller Beyond Ayahuasca, he brings over twenty years of ceremonial and mentorship experience to this individual work.

Begin With a Conversation

Every mentorship journey starts with a short, unhurried connection call with Roman — a chance to share where you are, ask questions, and sense together whether this work is the right fit.
